items.name: Airlie Oak Framed Art Print, Wrightsville Beach and Wilmington
items.alt: Framed art print of the Airlie Oak, a painterly Southern live oak with hanging Spanish moss and blush azaleas on warm ivory with a Wrightsville Beach and Wilmington caption, in a walnut frame above a light oak console in a coastal entryway, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A framed art print of the Airlie Oak, the roughly 500 year old Southern live oak at Airlie Gardens in Wilmington NC, set like a botanical plate on warm ivory with a Wrightsville Beach and Wilmington caption. Made to order.
facts: 11 x 14 in, 12 x 16 in or 16 x 20 in
Airlie Oak illustration with a Wrightsville Beach and Wilmington, North Carolina caption
